column1: # terminal layer — what install.sh writes for this layer.
# One line per entry, TAB-separated:  mode<TAB>src<TAB>dest
#   mode  copy | tree | block | json | post
#   src   path relative to this directory
#   dest  path relative to $HOME (no leading / or ~, no ..); "-" for post
# Kit content lives in kit-owned files under ~/.config/palmface/; your dotfiles only get a
# small palmface block that points at it.
